Step:  
10-04-1357 is April 10, 1357.  
48 weeks = 336 days. Add 4 days → 340 days subtracted.  
April 10 minus 340 days:  
Days in March 1357 = 31 → back to March 10 is 31 days subtracted (340 - 31 = 309 left).  
Continue subtracting full years: 1356 is a leap year (divisible by 4) → 366 days.  
309 - 366 = -57, so go into 1356 by 57 days before end of year.  
57 days before Dec 31, 1356: Dec has 31 days → Dec 4 is 27 days before Dec 31, need 57 days before Dec 31 → 57 days = 31 (Dec) + 26 (Nov) → Nov 30 is 31 days before Dec 31, so 57 days before Dec 31 is Nov 4, 1356.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1356-11-04
